items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: The Starter plan is {starterPrice}/month. No setup fee, no commitment. You start with {trialDays} days free. We ask for your card to begin the trial, with no charge before they are up.

items.question: Do I need to change my till?
items.answer: No. Stampeo works with any till, or with no till at all. You scan from our free app or straight from a browser. Zero integration required.

items.question: Do my customers have to download anything?
items.answer: No. Apple Wallet and Google Wallet are already installed on every recent smartphone. Your customers scan your QR code and their card is added in one move. That's it.

items.question: What happens when the free trial ends?
items.answer: You choose whether to continue. We ask for your card to start the trial, but nothing is charged before the {trialDays} days are up. You can cancel any time before then.

items.question: Is my data safe?
items.answer: Yes. Stampeo is GDPR compliant, our servers are in Europe, and we never resell your customer data. It's yours, and you export it whenever you want.

items.question: How many customers can I enroll?
items.answer: The Starter, Growth and Pro plans differ by features (notifications, broadcasts, advanced analytics), not by volume. See the pricing page for the details of each plan.

items.question: Can I change my card later?
items.answer: Yes. You can change the logo, colors, number of stamps and rewards at any time from your dashboard. Cards already installed on your customers' phones update automatically, with nothing to re-download.
